abstract_sentences.text: While diffusion models have achieved remarkable performance in image generation, they often struggle with the imbalanced datasets frequently encountered in real-world applications, resulting in significant performance degradation on minority classes.
In this paper, we identify model capacity allocation as a key and previously underexplored factor contributing to this issue, providing a perspective that is orthogonal to existing research.

Our empirical experiments and theoretical analysis reveal that majority classes monopolize an unnecessarily large portion of the model’s capacity, thereby restricting the representation of minority classes.
To address this, we propose Capacity Manipulation (CM), which explicitly reserves model capacity for minority classes.

Our approach leverages a low-rank decomposition of model parameters and introduces a capacity manipulation loss to allocate appropriate capacity for capturing minority knowledge, thus enhancing minority class representation.

Extensive experiments demonstrate that CM consistently and significantly improves the robustness of diffusion models on imbalanced datasets, and when combined with existing methods, further boosts overall performance.

final_judgment.single_storyline: class-imbalanced diffusion 中 majority 聚合梯度占用 shared capacity，使 minority information 落入脆弱参数；CM 以 low-rank θe 预留 capacity，再用 class-count-adaptive consistency/diversity output loss 分配 minority expertise，最后合并为标准推理模型。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: Fig.1 diagnostic、Eq.(1)–(4)、Theorem 2.1/3.1、Table 1–7、Many/Medium/Few split、多数据集/架构主结果、λ/rank/branch/loss ablations 与 merge/no-overhead 声明。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: proof、DDPM/CBDM/OC 公式、Algorithm C.1、完整超参、Mean±Std、human/downstream、broader settings、Overlap/classification extension 与大量视觉图。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig.1 将质量失败与 pruning sensitivity 同屏；Fig.2 连接 reservation、allocation、split performance；Table 7 用 θg-only 与 LCon/LDiv deletion 同时检验分支职责和损失必要性。
final_judgment.largest_gap: rank/pruning proxy 没有被真实 per-layer capacity map、gradient-share measurement、αr estimation 或 runtime/parameter accounting 直接验证；Theorem 3.1 依赖 simplified optimizer model，并省略部分 class-ratio dependence。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 资源分配主张应同时提供 resource proxy、组件反事实、matched structural alternative、异质性 split 和明确 uncertainty/运行单位，避免把 compiler-like decomposition 当作机制闭合。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适合有足够 minority samples、可用结构分支和 per-class evaluation 的长尾生成任务；single-digit/zero-shot、不可合并动态专家、模态差异大或无可靠分层指标时，本文证据不足。
